external_positions.enforced_by: cg_w09_validity.EXCLUDED_SESSION_CLASSES, tested in test_cg_w09_validity.py (the W10 door tests of the stacked slice re-test the same refusal from the consumer side)
external_positions.reason: every frame was taken with a hand on a probe; docs/05A §18 A-W09-03 makes a manual touch a physical invalidation, so these frames may never enter S1/S2/S4 or any thermal-response statistic

external_positions.action_required: the W04 owner must commit them; W09 parsing and door tooling are already verified against their format
external_positions.reason: the H8 monitor frames, including the raw #CG H8S lines behind the committed CSV and the post-mount door window, are present on the bench host but are not git-tracked on any branch; untracked bytes cannot anchor a published claim

external_positions.action_required: the H8 bench owner must commit the driver source; until then the mechanism is stated with its citation status, not with a quotation
external_positions.claim_kept: the contact polarity inverts every reading between the two settings, so door state needs a per-boot external attestation
external_positions.claim_rests_on: docs/01 §8.1/§8.2 plus the complementary mapping table that the W10 door slice stacked on this branch publishes as cg_w10_door.MAPPING_BY_POLARITY
external_positions.reason: firmware/h8-bench/main/h8_door.c and the bench console driver are quoted by the W10 door analysis as the code-level reason a frame cannot name its own door state, but no git ref in this repository carries those files; the same rule that excludes the untracked H8 frames applies to untracked source

measured_usability_of_the_candidate.the_two_counts_are_not_the_same_claim: rows_thermally_usable counts rows clean enough for a mixed-probe thermal statistic; rows_usable_for_baseline counts rows the S1 scenario can use, which additionally needs the door and environment domains qualified

policy: an invalid attempt is recorded, never deleted (docs/05A §18 A-W09-03)
a capture is not a run until the registry says it is eligible
a host fixture can never appear as a run in this registry
why_not_certified: certifying a baseline needs between-run repeatability, and one capture cannot show it
the capture's electrical columns are unqualified, so its energy baseline is unusable
the door was never in a machine-readable CLOSED state for the first 17 frames

the derived table carries no door_status, air_c_status, rh_pct_status or power_w_status column at all, so the door and environment domains cannot be qualified and no row of it is usable for the S1 scenario
